policy_revision_1.prompt_conditions: Gem constant with mineral, parameter and source; never a property of a specific stone
policy_revision_1.forbidden: Silently changing Product State; claiming quality of a specific specimen
policy_revision_1.conditions: Exact match of material, property and source

policy_revision_1.prompt_conditions: Only with ≈; one relevant weight/diameter pair; never a production tolerance
policy_revision_1.forbidden: Exact seat or production tolerances, certification
policy_revision_1.conditions: A specific stone needs a measurement

policy_revision_1.prompt_conditions: State the source system and rounding; not an ISO or legal certification
policy_revision_1.forbidden: Treating different national systems as legally identical
policy_revision_1.conditions: Record the source system and rounding step

policy_revision_1.prompt_conditions: Descriptive metal fraction only; 585 corresponds to 14K commercially, not literally
policy_revision_1.conditions: The formula does not replace a statutory assay check
Only the confirmed atomic fragment may be shown until atomized

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Assigning cleaning automatically for an unknown item
policy_revision_1.conditions: Needs fracture, treatment, coating and setting data

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Production tolerance, acceptance and regulatory control
policy_revision_1.conditions: Pure metals from an external reference

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Design tolerance, legal compliance, mandatory mass calculation, prompt or render
policy_revision_1.conditions: The alloy must match the grade exactly; values are calculated reference densities

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Legal PASS/FAIL; obligation without product-category analysis
policy_revision_1.conditions: Atomic norm with clause, edition, jurisdiction and date

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Automatic decisions beyond the proven content
Automatic decisions, regulatory checks, production calculation, prompt
policy_revision_1.conditions: State the incomplete verification and the source

policy_revision_1.forbidden: Showing as a fact, retrieval, automation
policy_revision_1.conditions: Kept only as a historical trace

invariants: Published revisions and release membership are never updated or deleted.
